name: weighted lying neck extension (with head harness)
description: Lying face down with a harness on your head, you lift against added weight to strengthen the muscles at the back of the neck.
instructions: Lie face down on a bench with your head past the edge and the weighted harness fitted.
Start with your chin tucked toward your chest.
Raise your head slowly until your face looks forward.
Pause, then lower back under control.
Use a light weight and smooth reps, never jerking the neck.
